# intel471-api-patterns

Read [`skills/intel471-api-patterns/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/intel471/integrations-skills/blob/main/skills/intel471-api-patterns/SKILL.md) before writing or changing

Patterns and traps for building integrations against the Intel 471 APIs — the Titan and Verity471 backends and their SDKs. Covers pagination, cursors, auth, rate limits, filtering, and known traps. Consult this whenever writing or debugging code that calls the Titan or Verity471 API/SDK, especially anything that pages through results (cursor / cursor_next / count+offset).
